run_benchmarks_across_commits: run histogram filling benchmarks across a range of git commits and store results in a shelve database
get_commits_list: get a list of all git commit hashes and their messages from the repository log
run_single_commit_benchmark: run the histogram_filling benchmark for a single git commit hash and print cpu time results
recursion_binary_benchmark: recursively benchmark commits using binary search to find performance regressions across a commit range
override_previous_results: override previous benchmark results by passing the -f flag to force re-running all benchmarks in the range
